# JRA-3Q wind speeds

JRA-3Q was download from the [NSF NCAR Research Data Archive (RDA)](https://rda.ucar.edu/). Was having issues downloading from [original source](https://jra.kishou.go.jp/JRA-3Q/index_en.html)

Use `submit.sbatch` to download and process data
